pages.title: Feather Pen
pages.text:
Used to write spells from the spell editing interface onto blocks and items.

$(l)Usage:$()
Right-click to write spell onto offhand item, Shift+right-click to write spell onto blocks within 3 blocks of crosshair.

pages.title: Feather Pen
pages.text: Special: Spells in armor trigger when taking damage and automatically push the attacker (when attacker is direct damage source), spells in items trigger on right-click，spells in blockItems is written into the newly generated block upon placement , spells in blocks trigger when block state changes and automatically push block coordinates.
